'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Floris de Vries DS Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Floris de Vries]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out of the Universe]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-4th-place-ds-floris-de-vries-hdadtj/ PC list]
